probes.input:
;; v1.4.0 — println with several args is a single `say:` with expressions
;; separated by spaces. Pinned for numbers; see KNOWN_ISSUES.md for the
;; string-literal case, which YS rejects at compile time rather than
;; printing the wrong thing.
(println 1 2 3)

expected_output.description: println with several numeric args; pins the space-separated multi-arg say emission

probes.input:
;; v1.4.0 — Clojure does not interpolate. A literal `$HOME` must stay literal;
;; emitting it into a YS double-quoted string instead makes YS look up HOME.
;; The second line also carries an escape, which forces a double-quoted YS
;; string, so the literal dollar has to survive that path too.
(println "cost is $5 and $HOME")
(println "path\n$HOME")

expected_output.description: literal $ stays literal in both single- and double-quoted YS emission; the second line also exercises an escape

probes.input:
;; v1.4.0 — a single quote inside a Clojure string must be doubled in a YS
;; single-quoted string; emitting it raw ends the scalar early.
(println "it's fine")

expected_output.description: a single quote inside a Clojure string is doubled, not left to terminate the YS scalar
